name: dinah
description: Dinah in VS Code: see which workbench this folder resolves to and which dinah binary the editor is talking to.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Dinah is not installed on this machine, and this build of the extension does not carry a binary for your platform. Install it from [github.com/paulmooreparks/dinah](https://github.com/paulmooreparks/dinah), or set `dinah.path` to a binary you already have.
[Open the Dinah settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22dinah%22)

No workbench was found from this folder. Run `dinah init` in a terminal to create one, or set `dinah.workbench` to the directory of one you already have.
[Open the Dinah settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22dinah%22)

Several workbenches are reachable from here. Set `dinah.workbench` to the one you mean.
[Open the Dinah settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22dinah%22)

Dinah has a binary for this window but no workbench to go with it. Open a folder to work from, or open the Dinah output channel to read what `dinah` reported.
[Open the Dinah settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22dinah%22)

Dinah found a binary for this window and is still looking for a workbench.

This text is replaced as soon as Dinah has an answer. If it stays, open the Dinah output channel to see what happened.

Looking for a dinah binary and a workbench.

This text is replaced as soon as the extension has an answer. If it stays, open the Dinah output channel to see what happened.

dinah.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `dinah` binary. Leave empty to use the one on your PATH, or the one carried inside this extension. A binary path is a property of the machine, so this setting does not travel through settings sync.

dinah.workbench.markdownDescription: Directory of the workbench to use for this folder, passed to `dinah` as `--workbench`. Leave empty to let `dinah` discover one by walking up from the folder. Set it when several workbenches are reachable, or when the walk reaches one you did not mean.

dinah.pollIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: How often the sidebar tree checks `dinah changes` for updates while visible.

dinah.watchFiles.markdownDescription: Watch the workbench's Markdown files for changes and check sooner than the poll interval when one is saved.
